offering_description.value: The company supplies drilling and wellbore tools to oil, gas and geothermal customers through its facilities. Its inspection facilities test, maintain and repair downhole components and rig equipment.

quotes.quote: Strength. We value their commitment to deliver quality and service excellence in support of our customers. With a robust and diverse inventory of tools, technology, and solutions, Drilling Tools International and its operating divisions are strongly positioned to support the oil, gas, and geothermal industries. Our facilities are strategically located across major global markets to ensure timely and efficient supply to our customers.

From a single weld to a full-on rig inspection, Downhole Inspection Solutions is the team to handle your specific needs. With one Canadian and four U.S. strategically located inspection facilities staffed by experienced and certified ASNT SNT-TC-1A Level II inspectors, DIS covers a wide range of inspection services. Our certified inspectors are equipped with advanced and calibrated non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. We are able to provide analysis, maintenance, and repair services to Bottom Hole Assembly (BHA) components and rig equipment to ensure that industry standards and customer specifications (TH Hill DS-1, API RP7G-2, etc.) are met or exceeded.

primary_products.value: Drilling stabilizers; reamers; wellbore conditioning systems

quotes.quote: A wellbore conditioning system that eliminates dedicated reamer runs. Well bore conditioning technology is required for enabling oil and gas operators to achieve the technical limits of today’s drilling challenges.
